drhp.business: Om Freight Forwarders operates in the logistics and allied services business as Clearing and Forwarding agents, Custom House Agents, Common Carriers Freight Booking Agents and Cargo Booking Agents in air and sea transport, and in the business of warehousing. It undertakes CHA & clearance, freight booking, shipping, transportation, vessel agency and stevedoring services, and is expanding into custom bonded and general/public warehousing to extend from 3PL into 4PL solutions.

risks.risk: Freight rate and operating cost volatility

risks.note: Changes in international trade policies, tariffs, geopolitical tensions, disruption of shipping routes and fluctuations in global trade volumes may affect cargo movement, freight rates, transit times and overall business volumes.

Operations involve coordination with shipping lines, transporters, ports and other third-party service providers; disruptions in their services, port congestion, capacity constraints or infrastructure-related interruptions may affect service delivery and operating costs.
risks.risk: Dependence on service providers and logistics infrastructure

risks.note: Transportation, cargo handling, loading and unloading activities involve risks of cargo loss or damage, accidents, delays and other operational incidents, which may result in claims, additional costs and reputational impact.

Operations are subject to various customs, EXIM, shipping, transportation, labour and other applicable laws and regulations; changes in requirements or non-compliance may result in additional costs, penalties or operational disruptions.

The logistics industry is highly competitive, including domestic and international logistics, freight forwarding, shipping and integrated supply-chain service providers; increased competition and pricing pressure may affect margins and market position.
Delays in collection or deterioration in the financial position of customers and other counterparties may affect working capital requirements and cash flows.
